cells.gaps: No source says the system is past its pilot, how the digital record is made in the pilot communes or where it is held: thirteen communes 'have' a biometric registration system (count 13, no total given; 12 in the ministry's own July 2026 presentation), which is not thirteen registering. Births and deaths entered digitally rest on one commune, Rumonge, in 2024; no plan with a period covering the as-at is on record (the only plan fact is a 2017 table entry), and no domestic budget line is stated for the civil platform.
cells.note: The ministry and the press describe pilot communes in August 2026, a platform awaiting its decree and a legal framework that still prescribes manual registration, with most acts in physical registers: rung 2. Rung 3 needs births past the pilot and live in some offices with the record made digitally, and no fact says so.
